node.title: Horizontes de memoria
node.summary: Use different time windows for local episodes, persistent patterns and regime shifts.

relations: Multiple memory horizons could help distinguish an event-specific reaction from a durable client preference.
No toda ausencia de compra es rechazo; stock, invitación, exposición y precio son confundidores. Los horizontes financieros no fijan los comerciales.
The later semantic-window account reframes historical factor selection around the protected outcome and useful response horizon, rather than maximum retained history.
